description.value: A small 9-site wilderness campground beside Schoen Lake on Vancouver Island, reached via a gravel forest service road; closed November through March due to slide risk, and subject to closure during extreme rainfall events — plan accordingly.

address.value: Atluck Rd, Woss, BC V0N 3P0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Schoen Lake Park exists as an active provincial campground, and the page did not load specific amenity details — only the site navigation rendered, with subpages returning 404 errors. OSM tags are the primary evidence source for concrete facts: capacity of 9 sites, a fee is charged, no internet access, and the operator is Namgis First Nation. No website content corroborates or contradicts any optional amenities, so nearly all amenity fields must remain null.
concerns: Website content only rendered site navigation; no park-specific amenity details were available from the fetched page. All optional amenities are unverifiable from website evidence.
Subpages (/about/, /about/news/, etc.) all returned 404 errors, suggesting the URL structure may have changed since the OSM record was created.
Phone number (+1-250-974-5556) is attributed to Namgis First Nation in OSM but could not be confirmed against the BC Parks website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active provincial campground listed on the official BC Parks website, with OSM confirming it is open and fee-paying. Suitable for inclusion in the directory as a legitimate camping stop for touring cyclists in a remote part of northern Vancouver Island.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM operator tag indicates Namgis First Nation manages this campground, which is consistent with Indigenous co-management arrangements common in BC provincial parks. The 9-site capacity makes this a very small campground.
